author: Harrison, S. P.
title: Linguistic evidence for Polynesian influence in the Gilbert Islands
notes: Consulted directly on 26 November 2026 (PDF of the volume in Downloads; tables read from page images). Argues that Polynesian influence on Gilbertese is lexical, not grammatical (§§1-3). §4.1: synchronic inventory (ten consonants, five vowels; t [s] before i). §4.2: historical phonology, POC > PMC > GIL vowels (p. 330), labials (p. 330), velars (p. 331), apicals and palatals (p. 332, the consonant charts after Jackson 1983: 308, 320), canonical shape (p. 333). §4.3: ten phonological criteria for Polynesian loans (p. 335) and the loans themselves (Appendix A).
